subject: EddyBridge MAP: capacity onramp & H100 pool sizing
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@eddybridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Saira Khan <saira.khan@eddybridge.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: EddyBridge capacity needs and timeline

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — EddyBridge is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the fallbacks for private deployments. We have a tight timeline and want to draft a mutual action plan (MAP) focused on Dedicated/Private lead times and GPU pool sizing. High level asks: 

- Required throughput: running a batch of 200 concurrent workers with 2k token sequences (p50 latency target ~200ms).
- Preferred models: open Llama 2 variants and a small set of quantized Llama-3 chx-type for production.
- Target go-live for private deployment: Aug 1 2025 (we understand hardware lead times may push this).

Can you share a draft MAP that includes: evaluation milestones, canary/acceptance criteria, procurement lead times for H100 vs A100, and an initial GPU pool sizing recommendation?

Attachments: our product brief (we'll upload after your response).

Best,
John
Director of AI Infrastructure
EddyBridge

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@eddybridge.com>
Cc: Saira Khan <saira.khan@eddybridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: EddyBridge capacity needs and timeline

John — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. We're eager to partner on this. I've looped in Ben (capacity/solutions) and Karthik (procurement + private onramp) to draft a MAP and sizing workbook.

Quick notes up-front:
- H100 lead times: if reserved now, typical procurement + rack provisioning for Private is 10-14 weeks for H100 inventory; Dedicated reserved capacity can be provisioned faster (3-4 weeks) depending on available pool.
- Initial sizing rule of thumb: for 200 concurrent workers at 2k tokens, estimate ~5–7 H100s for p95 latency headroom with batching/caching; quantized Llama-3 variants could bring that down by ~30%. We will run an eval to tune these numbers.

Next steps (draft MAP items):
1) Week 0: MAP kickoff + access agreement (we'll supply an NDA + Private eval addendum).
2) Week 1-2: Eval run (sample prompts, 24–48h stress window) — Redwood provides a pre-configured canary on Dedicated to validate throughput.
3) Week 3-6: Scale tests, quantization experiments, cost projection and recommended pool sizing.
4) Week 7-12: Procurement & provisioning for Private (if elected) + acceptance testing.

I'll attach a preliminary MAP and a sizing workbook (see attachments). Ben/Karthik — can you validate the lead-time ranges and sizing calc below?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
(t) +1 415-555-0187

Attachment stubs: EddyBridge_MAP_v1.2.pdf, GPU_Sizing_Workbook.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: EddyBridge capacity needs and timeline

Eve / Karthik — I ran a quick pass on the sizing workbook. Key points and conservative recommendations: 

- Baseline perf assumptions (Llama-3 quantized): ~45 tokens/sec per H100 v2 for the workload described (2k sequences, mixed batching). For 200 concurrent workers hitting steady-state, that approximates ~9–10 effective workers per GPU, so ~20 H100s to avoid queuing under bursty traffic.
- If they accept model quantization + prefix caching we can target 7–9 H100s for steady 200 workers (matches Evelyn's optimistic calc). We'll surface both: a performance-safe plan (20 H100s) and a cost-optimized plan (8 H100s plus aggressive caching and smaller model variants).
- Lead times & options:
  * Dedicated: can be carved from our hosted pool in 3 weeks if we prioritize capacity (elastic burst allowed during evaluation).
  * Private: procurement (order to rack) 10–14 weeks H100; if customer opts for A100 we might shorten to 6–8 weeks but with a known perf delta.

Ops notes for MAP: include a mandatory acceptance checklist: 1) 48h backlog-free throughput test, 2) regression eval on prompt set (<2% delta on QA metric), 3) SOC2 evidence handoff. We'll coordinate SOC2 artifacts; Karthik can confirm exact artifacts list.

I'll update GPU_Sizing_Workbook.xlsx with both plans and a slide with cost delta.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@eddybridge.com>
Cc: Saira Khan <saira.khan@eddybridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: EddyBridge capacity needs and timeline

John — looping back with a concise MAP proposal and two sizing options attached. TL;DR: we recommend starting evaluation on a Redwood Dedicated canary (provisioned within ~3 weeks) to validate their latency/throughput targets while we run parallel quantization tests. If results meet acceptance criteria, EddyBridge can choose:

Option A — Performance-safe (recommended for initial production): 20 H100s Private pool; procurement 10–14 weeks; go-live estimate: mid-August if PO is signed in early June.

Option B — Cost-optimized (fast path): 8 H100s (quantized Llama-3 + caching) via Dedicated and a small Private tranche later; initial Dedicated can be live in ~3 weeks; Private backfill later.

Acceptance checklist (short):
- 48h throughput pass (no queued requests at p95 target)
- Prompt-set regression <2% QA delta
- Security evidence review (SOC2 artifacts provided; see drive link)
- Sign-off: EddyBridge engineering + Redwood Solutions lead

Next asks for EddyBridge:
1) Confirm whether you want us to prioritize Dedicated canary or begin procurement conversations for Private H100 now.
2) Share preferred PO cadence and procurement contact for order timing (if Private).
3) Share initial prompt-set for regression testing (or allow Redwood to sample).

We'll schedule a 30-min MAP review this week to lock milestones. Proposed times: Wed 14 May 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 15 May 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
